svg.text: Detailed Logical ERD - JobPortal BD (entities, delete cascades and controller rules)
Built by reading the backend controllers and the frontend. Red tags R1..R13 point to the rules at the bottom; 'del:' shows what the delete endpoints remove in code.
jobs.type - list is in the frontend
jobs.mode - list is in the frontend
JWT in httpOnly cookie - NOT stored in DB
issued by login, verified on every request
status timeline shown to the applicant
specializes, disjoint by role (R9: admin cannot register)
DERIVED READ MODELS - shapes the controllers build for the screens (not stored, not entities)
built from: APPLICATION + USER + APPLICANT_PROFILE + JOB_POST
built from: APPLICATION + JOB_POST + USER + COMPANY_PROFILE
counts only, one document per request
RULES ENFORCED IN THE CONTROLLERS (R-tags used above)
ApplyJob: the job must exist, be active and before its deadline; one application per applicant per job (409); a resume file is required; the application starts as pending with a one-entry history.
WithdrawApplication: only the applicant's own application; refused when status = approved; deletes the application and its resume file.

UpdateApplicationStatus: only applications of the company's own jobs; status must be one of the 6 values; a history entry is added only when the status really changes; the interview note is stored when sent.
DeleteCandidate: a company removes an application of its own job and the resume file.
CreateJob: title, salary and a future deadline are required; slug is generated; status starts as active. UpdateJob also requires a future deadline when one is sent.
UpdateJob / TogglePauseJob / DeleteJob: only the company's own jobs; the company may set active or paused; TogglePauseJob refuses closed jobs (UpdateJob has no such check).
Admin CloseJob: sets status = closed and stores moderated_by. Admin DeleteJob: deletes the job and all its applications and resume files.

Admin DeleteApplicant: removes the user, all their applications + resume files and the photo. Admin DeleteCompany: removes the user, all applications to the company, all its jobs and the logo. All steps run one after another in code, without a transaction.

Registration: role may only be applicant or company (admin cannot register); e-mail must be unique and the password strong; a code valid for 10 minutes is mailed; login is refused until is_verified = true.
UpdateProfile: each role may change only its own allowed fields; a new photo or logo is uploaded and the previous Cloudinary file is deleted.
Public lists: GetJobs and GetLatestJobs return only active jobs; the public GetCompanies returns only verified companies, each with its open-job count.
Admin AddApplicant / AddCompany: the account is created already verified (no code) and added_by is set to the admin.
ForgotPassword creates a reset code (10 minutes); ResetPassword checks purpose = reset and expiry, saves the new password hash, clears the code and sets is_verified = true.
key that is also a reference
LOGICAL model derived from the code. The
database stores only 3 collections: users, jobs,
references checked in code, not by MongoDB.
'del:' = what happens when the owner is deleted.
MongoDB has no cascade rules, so the controllers
delete related data themselves (R8, R5, R7).
users keeps ONE shared field otpPurpose for both
code types, so only the latest purpose is kept.
Grey dashed boxes are not database entities:
the JWT access token (cookie) and the read
models the controllers build for the screens.
No notification, bookmark or message entity
exists in the code, so none is drawn.
